scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays product name, tagline, and primary call-to-action buttons correctly

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB homepage URL
steps.context: Browser at initial state with no cache

steps.description: Check that hero section is visible and contains required elements
Confirm Get Started and View on GitHub buttons are present and functional

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Product name 'MirDB' is prominently displayed
Tagline communicates 'Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol' or similar value proposition
Button navigates to Quick Start section or appropriate documentation
Button opens GitHub repository in new tab

scenarios.name: Navigation Header Functionality
scenarios.description: Verify navigation header contains all required links and provides easy access to page sections

steps.description: Navigate to the homepage
Verify presence of logo and navigation links
Click each navigation link and verify correct scrolling/navigation

test_cases.expected: Navigation contains Logo, Features, Commands, Quick Start, and GitHub links
Page scrolls to Key Features section
Page scrolls to Supported Commands section
Page scrolls to Quick Start section
Opens GitHub repository URL

scenarios.name: Key Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify key features are displayed in an organized, scannable format with accurate information

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the Key Features section
Check that all key features are displayed with descriptions

test_cases.expected: Section displays at least 5 key features: Memcached Protocol, Persistent Storage, LSM Tree Engine, Async I/O, Configurable
Feature card mentions 'drop-in compatibility with existing memcached clients'
Feature card mentions 'data survives restarts via SSTable file format'
Feature card mentions 'high-performance writes with background compaction'
Each feature card displays a recognizable icon

scenarios.name: Supported Commands Section
scenarios.description: Verify all supported commands are displayed with brief descriptions

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the Supported Commands section
Check that all supported commands are listed with descriptions

test_cases.expected: Section displays all 9 commands: SET, GET, DELETE, ADD, REPLACE, APPEND, PREPEND, INFO, MAJOR_COMPACTION
SET command shows description: 'Store a key-value pair'
GET command shows description: 'Retrieve value(s) by key'
DELETE command shows description: 'Remove a key'
INFO command shows description: 'Display database status'

scenarios.name: Quick Start Section with Code Snippets
scenarios.description: Verify quick start section displays accurate installation and usage code snippets

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the Quick Start section
Check that code snippets show correct installation and usage examples
Verify code blocks have copy-to-clipboard functionality

test_cases.expected: Section contains installation command 'cargo install mirdb' or equivalent
Code snippet shows 'mirdb -c config.toml' or similar startup command
Code snippet shows memcached client connection example using port 12333
Code snippet demonstrates SET command with expected 'STORED' response

test_cases.input: Click copy button on code block
test_cases.expected: Code is copied to clipboard successfully
Code blocks display with appropriate syntax highlighting

scenarios.name: Project Status and Roadmap Display
scenarios.description: Verify project status section shows implemented and planned features

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the Project Status/Roadmap section
Check that implemented and planned features are clearly distinguished

test_cases.expected: Section displays both implemented (checked) and planned (unchecked) features
Async Networking and Compaction are marked as implemented
Raft Consensus is marked as planned/in-progress
Implemented and planned features have clear visual distinction (checkmarks vs circles)

scenarios.name: Footer Section with Links and License
scenarios.description: Verify footer contains project links and license information

steps.description: Navigate to the footer section at bottom of page
Check that footer contains required links and license info

test_cases.expected: Footer contains links to GitHub, Documentation, and displays license information
Link navigates to MirDB GitHub repository
Link navigates to documentation resource
Footer displays MIT/Apache license information

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Desktop Viewport
scenarios.description: Verify homepage renders correctly on desktop viewports (1024px-2560px)

steps.description: Configure browser viewport to 1920x1080
Check that all sections display correctly at desktop size

test_cases.expected: All sections display correctly with proper spacing and alignment
Layout scales appropriately for large screens without breaking
Feature cards display in multi-column grid layout
Navigation displays full menu items (not hamburger menu)

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Tablet Viewport
scenarios.description: Verify homepage renders correctly on tablet viewports (768px-1023px)

steps.description: Configure browser viewport to 768x1024
Check that layout adapts appropriately for tablet size

test_cases.expected: All sections display correctly with adapted layout

test_cases.input: Check feature cards at tablet size
test_cases.expected: Feature cards adapt to 2-column or stacked layout

test_cases.input: Check code blocks at tablet size
test_cases.expected: Code blocks remain readable with horizontal scroll if needed
Navigation adapts appropriately (may show hamburger menu)

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Mobile Viewport
scenarios.description: Verify homepage renders correctly on mobile viewports (320px-767px)

steps.description: Configure browser viewport to 375x667 (iPhone 8)
Check that all sections stack vertically and remain usable

test_cases.expected: All sections display correctly in single-column layout
Page remains usable at minimum supported width
Navigation displays as hamburger menu or collapsed state
All interactive elements are at least 44x44 pixels
Code blocks are scrollable horizontally without breaking layout

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Keyboard Navigation
scenarios.description: Verify page is fully navigable using keyboard only

steps.description: Navigate to homepage using keyboard
Use Tab key to navigate through all interactive elements
Check that focus is visible on all interactive elements

test_cases.expected: All interactive elements are reachable via Tab key
Each focused element has visible focus indicator (outline or highlight)
Skip to content link appears on first Tab press
Buttons and links can be activated using Enter or Space key

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Screen Reader Compatibility
scenarios.description: Verify page content is accessible to screen readers

steps.description: Verify proper heading hierarchy and landmark regions
Verify all images have descriptive alt text
Verify interactive elements have appropriate ARIA labels

test_cases.expected: Page has proper heading hierarchy (h1 > h2 > h3) without skipping levels
Page uses semantic landmarks (header, main, nav, footer)
All images have descriptive alt text (or empty alt for decorative)
Code blocks are readable by screen readers with appropriate labels

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Color Contrast
scenarios.description: Verify text and interactive elements meet WCAG contrast requirements

steps.description: Check contrast ratios for all text elements

test_cases.expected: Normal text has contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1
Large text (18px+ or 14px+ bold) has contrast ratio of at least 3:1
Links are distinguishable from surrounding text (not just by color)
Button text has sufficient contrast against button background

scenarios.name: Page Load Performance
scenarios.description: Verify homepage loads within acceptable performance thresholds

steps.description: Load page and measure time to interactive
Execute Lighthouse performance audit

test_cases.expected: Page loads within 3 seconds (NFR-1)
Lighthouse performance score >= 80
FCP is under 1.8 seconds
LCP is under 2.5 seconds

scenarios.name: Cross-Browser Compatibility
scenarios.description: Verify homepage renders correctly across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge

steps.description: Load and verify all functionality in Chrome latest
Load and verify all functionality in Firefox latest
Load and verify all functionality in Safari latest
Load and verify all functionality in Edge latest

test_cases.expected: All sections render correctly, navigation works, code blocks display properly
All sections render correctly, navigation works, code blocks display properly
All sections render correctly, navigation works, code blocks display properly
All sections render correctly, navigation works, code blocks display properly

scenarios.name: SEO and Meta Tags
scenarios.description: Verify page has proper meta tags for search engine indexability

steps.description: Check meta tags in HTML head section
Check that HTML is semantically correct

test_cases.expected: Page has descriptive title tag containing 'MirDB'
Page has meta description describing MirDB's value proposition
Page has og:title, og:description, og:image meta tags
HTML passes W3C validation with no errors
Page has canonical link element

scenarios.name: Default Configuration Display
scenarios.description: Verify default configuration values are displayed for quick reference

steps.description: Find and navigate to configuration reference area
Check that default configuration values are accurate

test_cases.expected: Default listen address shows '0.0.0.0:12333'
Default memtable max size shows '4MB'
Default SSTable max size shows '100MB'
Default work directory shows '/tmp/mirdb'

scenarios.name: External Links Functionality
scenarios.description: Verify all external links (GitHub, documentation) open correctly

steps.description: Find all links pointing to external resources
Click each external link and verify destination

test_cases.expected: Opens MirDB GitHub repository in new tab
External links open in new tab
External links have rel='noopener noreferrer' for security
All external links return 200 OK status

scenarios.name: Typography and Visual Design
scenarios.description: Verify typography follows design requirements - monospace for code, sans-serif for body

steps.description: Check font families applied to different text elements
Check spacing, alignment, and visual hierarchy

test_cases.expected: Code blocks use monospace font family
Body text uses sans-serif font family
Headings have clear size hierarchy (h1 > h2 > h3)
Generous whitespace between sections for readability

scenarios.name: Content Accuracy Validation
scenarios.description: Verify all technical content accurately represents MirDB capabilities

steps.description: Read through all text content on the page
Cross-reference content with PRD requirements

test_cases.expected: Content accurately states Memcached protocol compatibility
Default port 12333 is correctly mentioned
All 9 supported commands are listed
Content accurately describes LSM Tree architecture
Content accurately describes SSTable-based persistence
